body.x: ALVISS.AI SAS launches the Alviss Assistant application to improve access to evidence-based biomedical information for everyone.
Alviss Assistant aims at improving access the quality biomedical information for everyone. This automated AI chatbot will provide an alternative to low-quality biomedical and health forums.

With Alviss Assistant users can ask any biomedical question and will get an automated evidence-based answer extracted from a scientifically valid source. It will also provide the link to the source of the information to improve the transparency of the answers.
Alviss Assistant is available on our commercial website and as a downloadable application on Android and IOS.

Dr. Pavel Overtchouk, founder of ALVISS.AI, comments: "Alviss Assistant is a revolutionary solution to a big problem that is the access to scientifically valid biomedical information. It will remain in beta for a while because the task it aims at accomplishing is difficult, but we wanted to make it available as soon as possible given the amount of circulating misinformation during this pandemic period. Alviss Assistant allows us to get closer to the mission of alviss.ai: improving access to quality scientific information for everyone."
- Web and mobile application working on all platforms: IOS, Android, Web.
- Available for download: in the App Store, Play Store and Huawei AppGallery.
- Users can save question / answer pairs: to test themselves later by saying “test”. This feature has an educational purpose and is fully automated.
- Vocal as well as written interaction is possible
